ir.name: rank_disagreement_margin_linear_clamped
ir.intuition: Select pairs with rank difference > 0 and objective order disagreement, weighting by linearly clamped margin emphasizing all rank disagreements without strict rank gap > 1 cutoff, increasing pair coverage to avoid empty pairs.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N]
    rank = feature_cache['rank']  # [B, N]
    batch_size, n = objective.shape
    rank_w = rank.unsqueeze(2)   # winner candidate [B, N, 1]
    rank_l = rank.unsqueeze(1)   # loser candidate  [B, 1, N]
    obj_w = objective.unsqueeze(2)
    obj_l = objective.unsqueeze(1)
    # Geometry: pairs where rank difference > 0 (allow adjacent and beyond)
    rank_diff = rank_l - rank_w  # positive if loser rank worse
    valid_rank_diff = rank_diff > 0
    # Objective disagreement: winner better or worse than loser, rejecting equal objectives
    obj_better = obj_w < obj_l
    obj_worse = obj_w > obj_l
    sign_disagree = torch.logical_or(obj_better, obj_worse)
    pair_mask = torch.logical_and(valid_rank_diff, sign_disagree)
    b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = pair_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        # fallback: allow pairs with rank_diff == 0 and objective disagreement to avoid empty pairs
        valid_rank_zero = rank_diff == 0
        fallback_mask = torch.logical_and(valid_rank_zero, sign_disagree)
        b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = fallback_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    margin = (objective[b_idx, l_idx] - objective[b_idx, w_idx]).abs()
    margin_clamped = torch.clamp(margin, min=1e-4, max=1.0)
    weight = margin_clamped
    max_pairs = extra.get('pairing_budget', 16)
    if weight.size(0) > max_pairs:
        _, top_idx = torch.topk(weight, max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[top_idx]
        w_idx = w_idx[top_idx]
        l_idx = l_idx[top_idx]
        weight = weight[top_idx]
    pair_idx = (b_idx.to(dtype=torch.int64), w_idx.to(dtype=torch.int64), l_idx.to(dtype=torch.int64))
    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=pair_idx,
        weight=weight,
        meta={'builder': 'rank_disagreement_margin_linear_clamped'}
    )

ir.name: weighted_advantage_exp_margin_logsigmoid_scaled_weighted_mean_loss_v4
ir.intuition: Replaced the linear scaling of (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) by normalizing advantage_gap with an exponential margin term to reduce similarity to prior losses. The margin is now computed as exp(clamped mean advantage) minus 1, giving a smooth, nonlinear adaptive margin. This avoids direct shift subtraction and linearly scaled inputs, introducing a structurally different transformation that still respects pairwise margin and debias properties while preserving weighted mean aggregation. This structural shift improves novelty and numeric stability.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
mean_adv = mean(advantage_gap)
margin = exp(clamp(abs(mean_adv), 0, 1)) - 1
norm = max(mean(norm(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
x_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = margin * x_raw
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
return sum(loss_weighted) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap)
    margin = ops.sub(ops.exp(ops.clamp(ops.abs(mean_adv), 0.0, 1.0)), 1.0)
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_mean
